assumptions.statement: Detailed regulatory controls, road redlines, ownership, municipal utilities, and engineering constraints must be confirmed from official attachments before statutory use.
assumptions.impact: The package can be reviewed as a formal AI submission only for provided official boundaries and submitted design layers; statutory controls still need professional confirmation.

assumptions.statement: Lack of official precise regulatory redline and municipal utility capacity data.
assumptions.impact: Provisional boundaries and scenario calculation models are applied; final metrics require recalculation upon official data release.

assumptions.statement: Policy uncertainties regarding autonomous driving and open-source algorithm testing in public space.
assumptions.impact: Tiered admission sandboxes (L1-L3) and human-in-the-loop fallback mechanisms are established.

assumptions.statement: Varying public acceptance and consensus regarding AI technology integration in historical heritage space.
assumptions.impact: Public participation, bilingual wayfinding, and non-digital alternative service channels are provided.

assumptions.statement: Long-term operation and maintenance funding gaps for public AI infrastructure.
assumptions.impact: Multi-agent investment models, open-source governance committee, and commercial lounge revenues are leveraged.
